existing_finding_connections.classification: Recovered059 tree triangle-count finding newly assessed against95e source; original Adler attribution and acceptance retained.
existing_finding_connections.canonical_owner: TreeLeafTriangleCount constructed from the actual retained leaf representation mesh, with biological source counts separately preserved.
existing_finding_connections.first_failed_contract: A count described as exact submitted triangles should agree with the representation mesh and its intended resident/visible population.
existing_finding_connections.trace: Current child creation counts every source leaf in each primary group and records source_count*2 for flat cards. The actual grouped flat-card mesh first discards one of four ordinal lanes per shoot, then emits six indices, or two triangles, per retained leaf. Oak emits16 and the checked-in beech preset emits12 leaves per shoot, so for complete nonempty shoots each has one quarter omitted: 16 source leaves produce12 cards and a component count32 versus24 mesh triangles; 12 source leaves produce9 cards and count24 versus18. The viewer sums this component for matching representations and writes scene_leaf_triangles to its report.
existing_finding_connections.safeguards: These are static source arithmetic and a source consumer trace, not a generated mesh, observed component, GPU submission, timing or report. The query does not filter by visibility, so its resident-versus-visible/submitted meaning requires an explicit policy decision; not every benchmark timing is claimed wrong. Shoot identity collision assumptions, all producers and exact aliases remain open.
dependencies: Trace all flat-card mesh producers, cached count owners and benchmark/report consumers.
Resolve resident, visible and submitted metric semantics, while retaining separate biological source counts.
acceptance_requirements: Cambered and flat-card metadata agree with their intended actual retained geometry for supported oak and beech.
Source, retained and visible/submitted quantities remain separately defined without retaining full mesh data solely to recompute them.
existing_finding_connections.discovery: partial; current producer/selection/mesh/count/report source and per-shoot arithmetic reassessed, visibility policy and all aliases open

existing_finding_connections.classification: Recovered059 tree streaming projected-view finding newly assessed against95e source and pinned native API; original attribution retained.
existing_finding_connections.canonical_owner: One admitted projected tree view and scale for residency demand, spawned representations and draw eligibility.
existing_finding_connections.first_failed_contract: A supported cold view should spawn the representation eligible under the same camera viewport and projection policy before relying on it for drawing.
existing_finding_connections.trace: Current visibility update scales with the camera physical viewport height and FOV relative to720 pixels, clamped0.25..4. Current streaming derives FOV and override scale but omits viewport height. Unlike6533, its first changed mask asks ensure_tree_assets_resident for EVERY_TREE_TIER and both leaf representations; however it still spawns child entities only from the distance-selected new_mask. Under the source counterfactual physical height2160, FOV80 degrees, no override and distance140m, the visibility scale is3 while streaming scale is1. The streaming mask contains only the whole-tree LOD4 bit; the source LOD3 range is72..96 entering and180..210 exiting, whereas LOD4 starts150..180. A cold root therefore requests a LOD4 child but not LOD3 even though all tier assets are requested.
existing_finding_connections.native_source: Pinned bevy_camera0.19.1 archive matches the95e Cargo.lock SHA-256. Its source defines physical_viewport_size in physical pixels, use_aabb=false as mesh-origin range, and is_visible_at_all as distance >= start_margin.start and < end_margin.end. This corroborates the interval interpretation; it is source inspection, not a Bevy execution.
existing_finding_connections.safeguards: No 2160-pixel viewport, camera transform, supported scene, scheduler, spawned child, native eligibility, image or render was observed. Supported target sizes, transform anchoring, exact frame ordering, asset readiness and all alias policy remain open. The old claim that the LOD3 asset itself is absent no longer follows from current source; distinguish prebuilt assets from unspawned children.
dependencies: Trace supported camera/viewport creation, child transform/visibility scheduling and first-scene readiness.
Unify projected view authority or otherwise demonstrate required spawned representation at supported cold views; distinguish asset residency from entity lifetime.
acceptance_requirements: Required representations exist and are eligible before drawing on supported cold approaches; do not rely solely on previously visited warm children.
Preserve intended LOD handoffs and budgets with shared projection meaning; assess the 2160/80/140 source case if the view is supported.
